spec.description:
Pink Thermal Slab is a high-performance commercial insulation
board consisting of a semi-rigid glasswool slab factory-laminated with a
Sisalation reflective foil laminate on one side. Engineered for commercial
concrete under-slab soffits, concrete roofs, floors, and plant room walls, it
controls temperature fluctuations and dampens structural and airborne noise.
Achieving an AS 5637.1 Group 1 NCC fire classification for ceiling linings and
CodeMark certification, it satisfies thermal performance, acoustic absorption,
and strict non-combustibility requirements.
features:
High-density
semi-rigid glasswool board combined with Sisalation reflective foil facing

Group 1 fire classification compliant with AS 5637.1 and AS ISO 9705 for wall
and ceiling linings

CodeMark certified (Certificate of Conformity CM 30006)
for NCC compliance

Delivers superior thermal performance to stabilize
concrete roof, floor, and wall temperatures

Exceptional acoustic sound
absorption reducing reverberation under concrete slabs

Non-combustible
glasswool core complying with AS 1530.1

Manufactured in Australia using up
to 80% recycled glass with bio-soluble FBS-1 formulation

Lightweight and easy
to cut and install using insulation anchors or pins

Low-VOC emissions
supporting Green Star indoor air quality requirements

technical.value:
Semi-rigid glasswool
board with Sisalation reflective foil laminate facing
Ignitability: 0, Spread of Flame: 0, Heat Evolved: 0, Smoke Developed: 0-1
High sound absorption under concrete slabs (NRC up to 1.00)

spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4859.1, AS 5637.1, CodeMark CM 30006, NCC 2022 Section J energy
efficiency compliance
spec.sustainability:
Contains up to 80% recycled glass;
bio-soluble FBS-1 formulation; zero ODP; low VOC
install:
Clean and
inspect underside of cured concrete slab, ensuring surface is dry and free of
release oils

Mark grid lines on soffit to align board joints neatly across
the ceiling

Position Pink Thermal Slab with foil facing downward (exposed)
against the concrete soffit

Fasten mechanically using approved insulation
anchors with large retaining washers (minimum 5 to 6 fixings per board)

Locate fixings approximately 100mm from edges and evenly distributed across the
board center
Butt boards tightly together to eliminate thermal bridging

Tape all exposed foil butt joints with 72mm reinforced aluminium foil tape to
form a continuous vapour barrier

Neatly cut boards around service pipes,
sprinklers, and penetrations using a sharp serrated knife
selection_checklist:
Confirm NCC Section J target Total R-value for the
carpark, basement, or suspended slab

Verify Group 1 fire rating requirement
for exposed ceiling/soffit linings

Measure slab area to calculate board
quantities (each 1200x2400mm board covers 2.88 m²)

Select correct thickness
based on required thermal R-value (50mm R1.5 to 110mm R3.5)

Order compatible
insulation anchors and 72mm reinforced foil tape
accessories:
Concrete
insulation anchors / pins with 50-75mm washers
limitations:
Not
designed for external weather exposure without protective cladding

Must be
mechanically fixed; adhesive alone is not recommended for overhead soffit
installations

Avoid puncturing the foil facing during maintenance to preserve
the vapour barrier

retrieval.rag_summary:
Fletcher Pink Thermal Slab is a semi-rigid, foil-faced glasswool
insulation board engineered for direct fixing to commercial concrete soffits,
roofs, and walls. Available in thicknesses from 50mm to 110mm (R1.5 to R3.5)
with a 1200mm x 2400mm format, it delivers excellent thermal control for NCC
Section J compliance while dampening carpark reverberation. Backed by CodeMark
certification (CM 30006) and an AS 5637.1 Group 1 fire rating, it provides an
aesthetic, non-combustible thermal barrier beneath commercial concrete slabs.
